scope: Read-only verification of every recording in the canonical AN19 stimulus manifest; no alignment or ASR performed by this audit

availability.collection_hash_definition: SHA256 of sorted unique source_wav_relpath UTF-8 bytes, NUL byte, and binary SHA256 digest of each real audio file; same algorithm as the archived extractor

byte_identical_recordings.handling: Retain both manifest identities; an alignment may be reused by byte hash plus identical transcript, without silently changing analysis weights

overlong_header.handling: Use actual decoded samples and duration. Do not pad to the overstated header duration. Existing Tr-24 frame count matches the decodable duration

known_source_exceptions.wave_wade: Lexical-label conflict remains separate from audio availability; forced alignment to a supplied word does not establish what the talker actually pronounced

annotation_only_transcript_override.reason: Single transposed-letter filename label; all other recordings at the same difficulty/item slot and the behavioral target use chief
annotation_only_transcript_override.scope: Intended alignment transcript only. Preserve original filename, manifest label, recording ID and audio. This is not independent verification of the produced pronunciation

hubert_feature_checks.audio_preprocessing: Entire mono recording, torchaudio resampling to 16000 Hz, feature-extractor normalization; no trimming or VAD

frame_geometry.phone_crop_recommendation: Select existing frame centers within [phone_start, phone_end); flag intervals containing no centers rather than inventing a frame
frame_geometry.historical_alternative: ctg.features.slice_by_time rounds T * time / recording_duration; this stretches frame locations over the entire recording and is not the exact convolution timing

audit_limits: Availability and source identity are verified, not phonetic labels or alignment accuracy
The audit compared full/reduced leaf shapes and stored feature hashes, not a fresh numerical HuBERT reproduction
Automatic alignment output must remain labelled automatic until independently checked
